title: Nearly a million evacuated as 'super typhoon' makes landfall in Philippines
summary: Typhoon Fung-wong with sustained winds of 185 km/h (115mph) make landfall on Sunday evening local time.

title: Super Typhoon Fung-wong kills two as it nears Philippines
summary: New typhoon comes days after Typhoon Kalmaegi left a trail of devastation across the Philippines, killing hundreds.
